newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil soybean areas to remain dry this week-Somar.
newsitem.headline: Brazil soybean areas to remain dry this week-Somar.

text.p: The weather is set to remain dry and stable in the key southern soybean growing regions and Mato Grosso do Sul state with scattered rains only seen at the end of the week, independent meteorologist Somar said.

Cloud cover is set to increase from March 19 although the chances of rain will remain slim. "On Friday, a weak cold front will reach the south of Rio Grande do Sul, causing an increase in cloudiness and isolated showers," Somar said.
In Mato Grosso state, clouds and isolated rains will alternate all week.

In the past week, the weather was dry in Brazil's southern soybean growing regions and the plains of central Argentina. Two weak cold fronts crossed Rio Grande do Sul and Parana, causing light isolated showers.
Meanwhile there were heavy showers and thunderstorms in Mato Grosso due to a low-pressure system, it said.
